article.title: 9/11 deeply touched all feelings of humanity says Mattarella
article.summary:
(ANSA) - ROME, 11 SET - President Sergio Mattarella reiterated Italy's commitment to combatting terrorism in his message for the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks.
"The painful memory of the terrorist attacks on the United States on the 11th of September 2001 remains etched onto everyone's conscience as an appalling page in the recent history of humanity," the head of State said.
"That day deeply touched all feelings of humanity.
"The Italian Republic renews its feelings of deep grief for the victims of those tragic events which marked a watershed in the course of contemporary history and led to subsequent new tragedies.
"Onerous was also the tribute of deaths and suffering paid also by the Italian American community in New York and in the other places involved in the terrorists' insane criminal design.
"On this anniversary, our heartfelt thought goes first to the families and to all those loved by those who were unjustly killed in or as a result of the terrorist attacks ...
